lines.junior: The lifting machine was never broken. A new carpenter who could not read had rebuilt its top from the wrong drawing. Okbun, who carries water to the builders, had seen Jeong's real drawing, so she tied a warning note to the rope in the night, with a water drop instead of a name. Once it was rebuilt from Jeong Yak-yong's drawing, the machine lifted the stone. Hwaseong Fortress was finished in 1796. Machines like Jeong's geojunggi helped lift its big stones, and a record book lists the workers and their pay.
lines.master: The lifting machine had never been broken: a new carpenter, unable to read, had rebuilt its top from the wrong drawing. Okbun, who carries water to the builders, had seen Jeong's own drawing, so in the night she tied a warning note to the rope, signed with a water drop rather than a name. Rebuilt from Jeong Yak-yong's drawing, the machine raised the stone. Hwaseong Fortress was completed in 1796; machines such as Jeong's geojunggi helped lift its massive stones, and a record book lists every worker and their pay.

The clerk: "I go home to sleep in town. The yard gate is shut at night."
Okbun: "I take water to the drawing room, and I fill the jars before dawn."

lines.rookie: Who tied the note to the rope?
lines.junior: Who tied the note to the rope? Check each person against your notes.
lines.master: Which of the four could have tied the note to the rope? Test each one against your notes.

lines.rookie: To write "the drawing is different", the writer had seen Jeong's drawing.
lines.junior: To write "the drawing is different", the writer must have seen Jeong's drawing.
lines.master: Anyone who wrote "the drawing is different" must already have seen Jeong's drawing.

lines.rookie: Check each person: the drawing room, the writing, the night. Only one fits all three.
lines.junior: Check each person for three things: the drawing room, the writing and the night. Only one fits all three.
lines.master: Test each person on three counts: the drawing room, the writing, the night. Only one passes all three.

lines.rookie: Okbun! Only she fits all three.
lines.junior: Okbun! She is the only one who fits all three.
lines.master: Okbun! She alone fits all three conditions.

lines.rookie: Okbun puts down her bucket.
lines.junior: Okbun sets down her bucket.
lines.master: Okbun lowers her bucket to the ground.

lines.rookie: "I saw the new top had no wheels," she says. "Jeong's drawing has two."
lines.junior: "I saw that the new top had no wheels," she says. "Jeong's drawing has two."
lines.master: "I noticed the new top had no wheels," she says, "but Jeong's drawing has two."

lines.rookie: The new top had no wheels. Jeong's drawing has two. So I wrote the note.
lines.junior: The new top had no wheels, but Jeong's drawing has two. So I wrote the note.
lines.master: The new top had no wheels, yet Jeong's drawing has two. That is why I wrote the note.

lines.rookie: I drew a water drop. Jeong knows the girl who brings his water.
lines.junior: I drew a water drop instead, because Jeong knows the girl who brings his water.
lines.master: Instead I drew a water drop; Jeong knows well the girl who brings his water.

lines.rookie: Then I thank the girl who brings my water.
lines.junior: Then I thank the girl who brings me my water.
lines.master: Then my thanks go to the girl who brings my water.

lines.rookie: My mother taught me the King's letters.
lines.junior: My mother taught me how to write the King's letters.
lines.master: It was my mother who taught me the King's letters.

lines.rookie: The next autumn, in the ninth month of 1796, Hwaseong Fortress was finished.
lines.junior: The next autumn, in the ninth month of 1796, Hwaseong Fortress was finished at last.
lines.master: The following autumn, in the ninth month of 1796, Hwaseong Fortress was completed.

lines.rookie: I cannot read or write.
lines.junior: I cannot read or write.
lines.master: I cannot read or write.

lines.rookie: The yard gate is shut at night.
lines.junior: The yard gate is shut at night.
lines.master: The yard gate is shut at night.

lines.rookie: Someone knew the drawing was different, and tied this note in the night. Who?
lines.junior: Someone knew that the drawing was different and tied this note in the night. Who?
lines.master: Someone knew the drawing had been changed, and tied this note in the dark. Who?

lines.junior: THE NEW WALL
